guard: An authorized relative sleep whose duration elapses before its first checkpoint mint completes without a pause. Checkpoint expiry, journal authorization, cancellation and existing-pause replay keep their original rules.

mutations.name: an elapsed relative sleep propagates its pre-mint expiry
mutations.afterRestore: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/runtime build && pnpm smoke:runtime-mesh-sleep && pnpm smoke:runtime-run-driver-auth && pnpm smoke:runtime-mesh-checkpoint
mutations.expectRed: S3775 elapsed relative sleep completes after the real broker pre-mint read
mutations.cell: S3775 elapsed relative sleep completes after the real broker pre-mint read
